'''Version 1.10.1''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on February 5th 2026.  It was 85.31 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

====<u>Fixes</u>====
* Fixed [[Stage IV Dispatcher]] missing head texture while in snow biome 
* Added impact crater structure 
* Removed sound eater human causing null exception error 
* Fixed null exception error with difficulty
* Fixed [[Stage IV Beckon|Stage IV Beckons]] that are underground during thunderstorms still picking you up and flinging you around even though the tornado is hidden 
* Fixed disc item and creative item having different colors 
* Fixed [[Ancient Dreadnaut]] visual bug + death crash 
* Infested Furnace has been fixed and is now operational 
* [[Thornshade]] effect now working as intended

====<u>Internal</u>====
* Code cleanups for performance improvements

====<u>Configuration</u>====
* [[Hijacked Skeleton|Skeleton]] & [[Hijacked Blaze|Blaze]] added to Hijacked list

====<u>Mobs</u>====
* [[Assimilated Human]] nametag "Kim" variant added

====<u>Structures</u>====
* Meteor structure
* Meteor structure loot conversion
